JobsMap reports no open roles at Wibmo as of 2 Nov 2026. **Conclusion: this specific vacancy is not publicly available (likely closed/filled).** Related but distinct/inactive Director of Engineering postings exist on Cutshort (via Zyoin, posted 25 Nov 2020; and a separate "Director Engineering" posted by Shirin AM).

## Hiring organisation & engineering leadership
- **Employer/hiring org:** Wibmo Inc. (a PayU company; PayU Digital Labs Pvt Ltd, Bengaluru). Acquired by PayU/Naspers in 2019.
- **Engineering leadership:** Alias Varghese — VP & Head of Engineering, Wibmo (LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/aliasvm). Wibmo leadership page: https://wibmo.com/leadership.
- CEO: Shailesh Paul. Company LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/wibmo.

## Recruiters / TA (public evidence only)
- **Prabhat Kumar** — Talent Acquisition Manager, Wibmo (oversees tech/product hiring incl. directors). LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/prabhat-kumar-3b982991. (Company-level recruiter evidence.)
- **Md A.** — Associate Director, Talent Acquisition at PayU (hires senior sales leaders for PayU Digital Labs/Wibmo). LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/amimahmad. (Company-level, sales-focused.)
- **Shirin AM** — former Sr. Executive HR at Wibmo (Nov 2017–Dec 2021); posted "Director Engineering" at Wibmo on Cutshort. Now Deputy Manager TA at Paytm/Odessa. (Historical company-level recruiter evidence.)
- **Rakesh Ranjan / Zyoin Group** — co-founder & COO; posted "Director of Engineering" at Wibmo via Zyoin on Cutshort (25 Nov 2020). LinkedIn: https://linkedin.com/in/rakeshranjanzyoin. (Agency recruiter; vacancy-specific linkage to the Adzuna ID unconfirmed.)
- **divya Barathi** — listed as Wibmo team member on Cutshort; no public email/LinkedIn found. (Limited evidence.)

- Careers: https://www.wibmo.co/careers ; footer "Discover Jobs" on https://wibmo.com

- PayU careers (Wibmo roles): https://careers.payu.in
